description: Skips a job or restores a skipped job. Skipping cancels a swipe only if it has not yet been queued; it does not cancel an already queued application.

idempotency_key.description: Repeating a call with the same key and arguments returns its first result instead of acting again.

job_id.description: A job id from search_jobs, get_job_from_link or list_applications.

signal.description: Whether the user is not interested in this job, or wants an earlier skip taken back.

name: set_job_feedback

job_id.description: The job the feedback was recorded for.

signal.description: The signal stored: not_interested, or undo once the skip was taken back.

skipped.description: True while the job is skipped.

title: Skip or restore a job
